title: Prosociality by Coupling, Not Mere Observation: Homeostatic Sharing in an Inspectable Recurrent Artificial Life Agent
reasoning: The paper investigates the mechanistic basis for prosocial-like behavior (helping) in a recurrent artificial life agent through homeostatic coupling. While it mentions prosociality and references philosophical concepts, it explicitly states it is not making claims about moral status or empathy, focusing instead on control architecture rather than evaluating moral or ethical systems.
